title: crates/sieve: skeleton + sieve-rs dependency
description: Create crates/sieve/ as a lib crate wrapping sieve-rs 0.7. Add to workspace. Cargo.toml deps: sieve-rs 0.7, mail-parser 0.11 (for RFC 5322 parsing), tracing. Declare public API surface in src/lib.rs: pub struct CompiledScript(sieve_rs::Sieve); pub struct SieveEngine; pub enum SieveAction { Keep, FileInto(String), Discard, Reject(String) }; pub fn compile(script_bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<CompiledScript, String>; pub fn evaluate(script: &CompiledScript, raw_message: &[u8], envelope_from: &str, envelope_to: &str) -> Vec<SieveAction>. The evaluate fn: build a sieve_rs::Runtime, create a filter from the compiled script, feed the raw message bytes via mail-parser, run the event loop collecting fileinto/keep/discard/reject events into SieveAction, return the list. If the script produces no terminal action, append SieveAction::Keep (implicit keep per RFC 5228 §2.10.2).
